overview: AFL0001 (ATLFIL0001) is a band pass filter for 865/868 MHz applications. It supports European and Indian-region ISM radio applications and is designed for low insertion loss, low pass-band ripple and high ultimate attenuation.
The filter passes 863–870 MHz with a 50 Ω impedance, a maximum VSWR of 1.22 and a maximum ripple of 0.2 dB, and rejects 55 dB across DC to 833 MHz and across 903 to 3000 MHz. It handles up to 30 W.
It is housed in an IP67-rated enclosure with N-type male to N-type female connectors and operates from −30 °C to +70 °C, which suits outdoor gateway and base-station installations.
